title: Quit India & Other Stories

vibeProfile.oneLine: Short stories by the bold Urdu writer Ismat Chughtai.

summary: A collection of short stories by Ismat Chughtai, the fearless Urdu writer who scandalised and delighted mid-century India with her frank, sharp-eyed portraits of middle-class Muslim women's lives. These stories take up desire, hypocrisy, class and the small rebellions of women hemmed in by convention, told in her signature earthy, unsentimental voice. A fine gathering from one of the boldest and most beloved figures in modern Urdu literature.
whyReadIt: The fearless Ismat Chughtai on Muslim women's lives, desire and hypocrisy. Earthy, sharp and unsentimental.

funFacts.text: Chughtai was once tried for obscenity over her frank story 'Lihaaf' (The Quilt).
